notes.title: Blade & Soul Heroes Launch Time: 6AM PDT
notes.content:
Launch Time Announcement 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649513/1fc4834c25235136c3b7e617a8b656dfdc70327e.jpg"]



Set your alarms! ⏰ Blade & Soul Heroes launches at 6AM PDT on September 24th, 2025! Check your time zone so you can start playing the game right when servers open!

We are so excited for you all to experience the game next week! 🤩



Also, take a look at our latest gameplay trailer, Battle & World! Prepare for battle with diverse combat modes with your 5-hero team in this anime-inspired world called the Earthen Realm.

If you haven’t already, make sure to Wishlist now!
